title: Registry gate allowed outbound fetch calls through static aliases

reproduction.beforeFix: The source-isolation gate returned pass because its text rule only recognized a call written directly as fetch(...).
reproduction.afterFix: Invoked fetch aliases, window.fetch, computed window['fetch'], statically bound functions, and destructured fetch aliases from the browser global fail the source-isolation gate.

rootCause: Outbound request detection used direct-call text patterns for fetch and did not resolve a statically aliased function expression in the TypeScript AST.
remediation: Resolve direct browser fetch references, member accesses, and static variable aliases in the AST; reject a call through any resolved fetch function without executing resource source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "outbound requests through a static fetch alias"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: a request through a fetch alias returned pass
validation.runtimeBoundary: This is local source-gate evidence. The isolated preview CSP still provides runtime network denial and requires deployed verification.
